name: netdust-gates
description: 0.9.0: /feature-review honours REVIEW_LEVEL (low · full · ultra, which checks collisions with staging before landing) and ends with a Findings line; /review-fix <feature> turns a saved review into follow-up commits on the branch, the way a PR's review comments become commits, and keeps the record in specs/<feature>/review.md. 0.8.1: /shakeout on a branch with no spec derives the changed surfaces from the diff, explores them, proposes specs/<feature>/flows.md and stops for Stefan's approval; shakeout-qa then drives only the approved flows, so a hand-started feature reaches make e2e too. 0.8.0: /feature-review runs the reviewers on a feature (plan or none) or on where staging's features meet, and reports back; Close step 3 is make review name=<feature>. Eval case close-calls-make-review. 0.7.0: the plan is the feature. A spec split into sub-projects stays at specs/<topic>/spec.md; each plan is specs/<feature>/plan.md with a Spec: line, one plan per feature/<feature> branch, with no dependency declared between plans. /plan-review <topic> reviews the whole set in one dispatch, and plan-reviewer judges the cut: too broad, artificially split, or a requirement owned by no plan or by two. Close ends with the branch pushed and make promote handed to Stefan; the feature shake-out writes the checks, and make e2e env=staging is the gate ship waits for (devops 0.7.7). Eval cases: spec-splits-into-plans, plan-review-flags-artificial-split, close-hands-over-promote. 0.4.3: the Stop hook never touches git — it writes memory/ and tasks/, and keeps its watermark sidecar out of git status through the checkout's own .git/info/exclude; no more .gitignore edits or auto-capture commits on whatever branch was checked out (a deploy rung included). Committing memory is the author's job, on a feature branch. 0.4.2: the WordPress pack is enforceable as text — each Global Constraint names its evidence (a quoted command or the review that owns it), a red-flags table travels verbatim into the plan, and the whole-branch review on WordPress is joined by ntdst-drift-reviewer; eval case wp-constraints-carry-evidence. 0.4.1: the plan-review floor is gone — no plan state, reviewed or not, blocks a code edit; /plan-review stays a practice for a plan that exists. 0.4.0: two on-demand reviews, both report-only until Stefan approves. /session-review <feature> — a read-only session-reviewer checks the task reports, rulings, plan and diff against the real source on six dimensions (correctness, architecture, simplicity, core fit via core-fit.md on WordPress, tests, user-facing consequences), security-sentinel when it says so. /session-learn [session] — a read-only session-learner reads a transcript (superpowers' context-safety and path:line discipline) for Stefan's corrections, gates fired or bypassed, skills missed, rulings and failed premises, and proposes lessons with eval cases; superpowers-caused findings route to superpowers:diagnosing-superpowers. 0.3.0: the checks registry — every shake-out registers what it leaves in specs/CHECKS.md: the flows it drove as @e2e (make e2e env=staging, the proof after a deploy or a plugin update) and a fixture-free, read-only @smoke check per surface (make smoke, production too). shakeout-check fails a driven feature with no e2e or no smoke row, a missing test, a test without its tier's tag; /shakeout reads the registry first. 0.2.0: /plan-review — a fresh plan-reviewer subagent ground-truths the plan's premises against the source before Stefan reads it, files specs/<f>/plan-review.md naming the plan's blob, and the guard refuses product code while a plan open on this branch has no review of its current text. Netdust's software-delivery policy over superpowers: standards injected into the spec and plan, verification by executables (make gate, the shake-out manifest check), authority hooks. Pilot on netdust.be; replaces netdust-agent there and never runs beside it.
